Name: Relic of Devotion
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Adds a relic with a drop chance of 1/1000 by default

The relic when gifted to an npc instantly maxes your relationship with them.

Example: 
Marriage candidates at 8 hearts.
Non marriageable NPCs at 10.
Lastly spouses at 14.


Dialogue box not included (May be released in the future)
